{{recipe}}

This is a delicious, refreshing, and simple Brazilian [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]]. It does have some alcohol, but a non-alcoholic blackcurrant syrup could be substituted.

==Ingredients ==
* 1 ripe [[cookbook:papaya|papaya]]
* 1 scoop vanilla [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[cookbook:blackcurrant|blackcurrant liqueur]]
* 1 sprig of [[cookbook:mint|mint]] for decoration (optional)

== Procedure ==

=== Method 1 ===
#Peel papaya and remove seeds. [[cookbook:Cube|Cube]] the papaya. 
#Put papaya pieces in [[cookbook:blender|blender]] with ice cream and blackcurrant liqueur. [[cookbook:Puree|Blend]] well until smooth. 
#Pour into a small bowl and decorate with mint. 

=== Method 2 ===
#Peel papaya and remove seeds. Cube the papaya. 
#Put papaya pieces in blender with ice cream and blend until creamy consistency. 
#Pour some blackcurrant liqueur on the bottom of a large dessert glass. 
#Add the cream mixture. Add a swirl of blackcurrant liqueur on the top. 

=== Method 3 ===
#Cut papaya in half and remove seeds. Scoop papaya from peel with a spoon (this is easier and cleaner than peeling the fruit). 
#Place approximately equal portions of papaya and vanilla ice cream in a blender. Blend until creamy. 
#Place the mixture into a serving dish and pour about an ounce of [[Bartending/Alcohol/Crème liqueur#Crème de Cassis|Crème de Cassis]] on top.
